category.label: Structure & sections
category.summary: 4/4 core sections recognised; 2 non-standard headings; 0 undated roles.

findings.explanation: "PROFICIENCY" is not a heading parsers recognise. Section mapping is a lookup against a fixed list; Workday and Taleo file unrecognised sections under "other" or drop them.
findings.fix: Rename to "Skills".

findings.explanation: "WHERE I HAVE WORKED" is not a heading parsers recognise. Section mapping is a lookup against a fixed list; Workday and Taleo file unrecognised sections under "other" or drop them.
findings.fix: Rename to "Experience".

findings.explanation: Only 163 words. Keyword matchers work on frequency; there is not enough text here to match anything.
findings.fix: Add bullets under each role and a skills list.

findings.explanation: Dates are written 2 different ways ("June 2021 - Present" vs "2018 - 2020"). Some parsers only recognise one pattern per document.
findings.fix: Use one format everywhere, ideally "Jan 2022 – Mar 2024".

findings.explanation: Education comes before Experience although you have about 8 years of work. Recruiters read top-down for six seconds; the degree is not the headline any more.
findings.fix: Move Experience above Education.

category.label: Contact & metadata
category.summary: 4/4 core fields found; email, phone, linkedin, location only in a header/footer.

findings.explanation: Your email sits in the page header. Parsers that read the body only (most of them) never see it.
findings.fix: Move it into the body directly under your name.

findings.explanation: Your phone sits in the page header. Parsers that read the body only (most of them) never see it.
findings.fix: Move it into the body directly under your name.

findings.explanation: Your location sits in the page header. Parsers that read the body only (most of them) never see it.

category.label: Parse integrity
category.summary: 2 columns, 0 tables; 2 lines invisible to parsers, 12 scrambled.

findings.explanation: 2-column layout. A position-sorting parser merges both columns line by line: it reads "SKILLS ABOUT ME" as a single sentence. 12 lines are scrambled this way.
findings.fix: Rebuild as one column, top to bottom: contact, summary, experience, education, skills.

findings.explanation: Your contact line lives in the page header region. Most parsers extract body text only; the email and phone on this line never reach the candidate record.
findings.fix: Move the contact line into the body, directly below your name.

findings.explanation: Footer text ("Page 1 of 1") is skipped by parsers; harmless here, but it can be misread as body text by the ones that do read it.
findings.fix: Remove the footer.

category.summary: 9 weak openers, 6 generic phrases, 2 filler words.

findings.quote: Responsible for managing social media accounts.
findings.explanation: Opens with "Responsible for". That phrase describes a duty, not an action, and recruiters skim past it.
findings.fix: Delete "Responsible for" and start with the verb: what did you build, cut, launch or fix?

findings.quote: Helped with email campaigns and newsletters.

findings.quote: Results-driven and passionate marketing professional with experience in various marketing tasks. I am a hard worker who thinks outside the box and is seeking a dynamic role where I can leverage my skills.
findings.explanation: Uses first person. Resume convention is implied subject ("Built…", not "I built…"); parsers and recruiters expect it.
findings.fix: Remove "I", "my", "we" and start each line with the verb.

findings.quote: Results-driven and passionate marketing professional with experience in various marketing tasks. I am a hard worker who thinks outside the box and is seeking a dynamic role where I can leverage my skills.
findings.explanation: The summary talks about what you are seeking ("seeking"). Recruiters want what you have done; objectives went out a decade ago.
findings.fix: Rewrite the summary as two lines of fact: role, years, domain, one or two headline numbers.

findings.quote: Results-driven and passionate marketing professional with experience in various marketing tasks. I am a hard worker who thinks outside the box and is seeking a dynamic role where I can leverage my skills.
